coordinate_system: Original 256x256 canvas, x rightwards and y downwards. Boxes use exclusive right/bottom endpoints.
manual_precision: Visual annotation on enlarged native-pixel grid; approximately ±1 native pixel. Not an anatomical or subpixel model prediction.

definitions.eye_center: Center of visible eye-component bounding box, not inferred anatomical pupil center.
definitions.inner_gap: Horizontal empty span between the left box right endpoint and right box left endpoint. Eyeliner is included; eyebrows and hair are excluded.
definitions.eye_to_nose: Vertical difference between mean eye-box center y and visible nose-mark center.
definitions.nose_to_mouth: Vertical difference between nose-mark center and mouth-line center.
definitions.cheek_width: Approximate visible cheek contour cross-section below the eyes; contextual only, not complete head or hat width.

Vertin_v14.eye_source: manual visual bounds; hair-obscured edge is approximate

Vertin_trial.eye_source: exact transferred pixel mapping from transfer_validation.json

Courier.eye_source: the exact selected source pixels used in transfer; excludes donor hair and skin

Texas.eye_source: manual visual bounds; nose is a faint simplified mark

Zima.eye_source: manual visual bounds; fringe slightly occludes upper edge
